COSMIC 1.11 Desktop Environment Released

By Jane Writer, October 20, 2026

System76 released COSMIC 1.11 today as the latest stable version of its Rust-based desktop environment for modern GNU/Linux distributions, three weeks after COSMIC 1.10.

The release adds new options in COSMIC Settings to toggle tap-to-click and tap-and-drag on touchpads, implements the Wayland xdg-dialog-v1 protocol for better modal dialogs, and improves handling of multi-GPU and hybrid graphics systems.

Several applications received fixes as well: the Files app copes better with large folders, the Terminal remembers its window size, and the Store shows clearer update progress.

COSMIC 1.11 is available now in Pop!_OS and should arrive in the repositories of other distributions shipping COSMIC over the coming days.
